headline: Vision through the build.
subhead:
You saw it somewhere.
We built it.
lede: I’m Bogdan, a builder in Winnipeg. An idea reaches me, and I build it into something you can touch: simulators, explorers, data tools and brands. Many threads at once, one swarming mind.
about: I build the things I'd want to stumble on online: drone simulators, science toys, data machines and small worlds you can poke at.
By day I run the systems behind a B2B ingredient brand (that work lives in the NDA folder). By night it's БОГMODE: five divisions, five totems, too many tabs open.
I fly GPS and FPV drones, train Muay Thai, and think in English, Ukrainian and Russian, sometimes in the same sentence.
Got an idea that needs building, a drone problem, or just want to trade notes? Come say hi. I reply to everything.

contact.formIntro: Questions about the work, or something you would like to talk through? Send a note and I will reply personally.
